title: Address a named bot without starting a computer
description:
As a household member, I want a named bot to answer a text-only message without starting the shared computer, so that simple work begins immediately and costs no computer time.

Not included: tool calls or messages that require the computer.

Feature: Computerless bot turn

Scenario: Answer a text-only message
  Given an authenticated household member has a channel with a named bot
  And the household computer is stopped
  When the member sends a message that the bot can answer without tools
  Then the addressed bot completes one turn
  And the channel contains one durable bot answer
  And the household computer remains stopped

Scenario: Reject a cross-tenant message
  Given another tenant knows the channel identifier
  When that tenant tries to post or read the turn
  Then access is denied
  And the channel is unchanged
